<!----------------------------------------------------------------------
To add a module:

1. Run `pnpm sync <name> <org>/<repo>` to create `modules/<name>.yml`.
2. Set `category` to one of the values in `lib/categories.ts`.
3. Optionally add an icon to `icons/` and reference it with `icon`.

If the module mainly loads a third-party script (analytics, chat widget,
consent manager, captcha, ads), check https://scripts.nuxt.com/scripts first.

If you used AI tools to help with this contribution, please ensure the PR
description reflects your own understanding.

Write in your own voice rather than copying AI-generated text.
